design.intent: Create an original RetroVault-owned NES presentation that evokes the visual character of home console play while remaining clean, game-focused, and suitable for long play sessions.
design.originality: The bezel composition, frame treatment, layout, materials, RetroVault branding, and presentation design must be original RetroVault work and must not reproduce third-party bezel artwork, console photography, or external pack artwork. Platform identification may include third-party trademark references when deliberately specified; ownership of those marks is not claimed by RetroVault.

composition.game_view: Centered transparent gameplay aperture with presentation framing that does not obscure gameplay. The aperture does not define the emulated game's display aspect ratio.
composition.frame: Purpose-built RetroVault frame with restrained late-1980s home-console industrial character.
composition.surround: Dark neutral presentation field designed to keep visual attention on gameplay.
composition.depth: Subtle layered depth may be used around the game viewport without creating excessive visual bulk.
composition.branding: RetroVault is the primary presentation identity. Platform identification is secondary and remains visually subordinate to RetroVault and gameplay.

game_viewport.policy: The production overlay artwork is fully transparent inside this exact rectangle. Gameplay geometry remains controlled independently by RetroArch and the active shader/presentation pipeline.

safe_zone.policy: Branding must remain outside the transparent gameplay aperture. The approved NES master places RetroVault and system identity in the lower presentation area.

runtime.game_aspect_policy: 4:3 is the intended presentation aspect for NES gameplay. RetroArch and the active shader pipeline control final gameplay geometry independently inside the transparent overlay aperture.

retrovault_identity.accent: RetroVault wordmark flanked by restrained horizontal red accent lines.

system_identity.accent: System identity is centered beneath RetroVault without flanking red lines.

branding_layout.hierarchy: Gameplay remains visually dominant. RetroVault is centered below the gameplay aperture with red accent lines. System identity is centered directly beneath RetroVault.

finish.frame: Clean restored-console presentation with subtle material texture and restrained age character.
finish.controls: POWER and RESET controls should appear maintained and clean but naturally used, with subtle wear appropriate to functional physical controls.
finish.branding: Branding must be exceptionally crisp, precisely aligned, evenly spaced, and visually cleaner than the surrounding functional controls.
finish.consistency: This premium restored-hardware presentation language is the master direction for native RetroVault bezel and overlay families.

catalog.attribution: Original RetroVault bezel composition. Platform names and trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

trademark_policy.ownership_claim: RetroVault claims ownership only of its original bezel composition, presentation design, and RetroVault branding.
trademark_policy.platform_identity: Nintendo platform identification is included as secondary system identification and is not claimed as RetroVault intellectual property.
trademark_policy.separation: Third-party platform identity must remain distinct from RetroVault branding and must not imply ownership of the third-party mark.
